title: Change Email: Let Users Update Their Email Address | Orchard Core
description:
By default, the Email field on the edit page of an existing user can't be edited, so a user has no way to change the email address of their own account.

The Users Change Email feature adds a Change Email item to the user menu and a page where a signed-in user enters a different address. This video enables the feature, turns on its setting, and follows a user through the change.

In this video:
• What the feature adds
• Enable the feature
• Turn on the setting
• Change an email address
• What the page checks
• Summary
